title: GeoPackage/GIS: pure ooRexx remains the portable correctness route
summary: The GeoPackage baseline is a pure-ooRexx direct reader and is therefore cross-platform and independent of external GIS/sqlite libraries. A future Foreign Runtime sqlite3/spatial accelerator may be a faster, higher-priority implementation of the same upper contract, but it does not replace the portable reader; the ooRexx implementation remains the dependency-free reference/fallback and correctness oracle.
invariants: OOREXX_NATIVE is a first-class implementation kind, not a synonym for slow fallback.
The portable GeoPackage reader must remain usable without sqlite3, GDAL or platform-native GIS libraries.
Foreign Runtime acceleration is optional and separately qualified.
The accelerated implementation must publish capability differences rather than pretending exact parity.
The pure ooRexx path remains the correctness/reference route when acceleration is absent or ineligible.

provenance.claim: The GeoPackage pure-ooRexx direct reader is the portable native baseline; future Foreign Runtime acceleration is separate and does not replace it.
The planned GeoPackage accelerator preserves GeoPackageOoRexxBackend as dependency-free reference/fallback and correctness oracle.
